description: CLK1 (2m, the wanted signal is the fundamental) through 12 cm of pigtail, a rebuilt home-made 7-pole low-pass filter on a PCB with a ground plane (unscreened), and a measured 37 dB pad set

chain.name: 12 cm pigtail from the Si5351 board to the filter
chain.notes: moves the filter away from the board to reduce high-frequency coupling between them; type not recorded

chain.name: 7-pole low-pass
chain.part: home built on a PCB with a ground plane underneath, better constructed than the 9-pole
chain.notes: designed cutoff about 155 MHz (measured -3 dB point 149 MHz); not screened

chain.name: pad set
chain.notes: measured, not the labels: the 27-33-27 ohm T pad (15 dB) in series with the BNC attenuator marked 10 dB (really 27 dB), joined with SMA/BNC adapters. Measured together without a filter on 2026-10-31 as 37.4 dB at 145 MHz (36.9 to 38.4 dB from 20 to 180 MHz).

notes: Compare with 2m-chebyshev-lpf-163MHz-37dB (the earlier 9-pole, no pigtail). Same pad set. Changes from that run: a different filter (7-pole, rebuilt) and the 15 cm pigtail, so the two effects cannot be separated by these two runs alone.
